childId.description: 🆔️ The child's member identity. A content-addressed child (one whose identity follows its content) carries a `ContentId`.

ContentId.description: 🆔️ `<prefix>-` + the first 16 lowercase hex digits of SHA-256 over the child's canonical content bytes (several fields joined with U+001F). Rust `store::content_id`, TypeScript `contentId`.
